title: How do you do? / Are they … or …?
subtitle: 您好！/ 他们是……还是……？

lead.question: 第一次见客户，除了 Hello，英语里更正式的那句「您好」怎么说？怎么问别人的职业？
lead.warmup: 先别看课文，想象你带朋友参观公司：你要把同事一一介绍给对方，问「他们是做什么工作的」，还要在两者中二选一——中文说「他们是打字员还是空姐」，英文会用 or 把两个选项连起来。先自己试一句「他们是护士还是家庭主妇」，再听录音核对。
goals: 能用 How do you do? 初次见面正式问候并同样回答
能用 What are their jobs? / They're … 询问与说明职业
能用 Are they A or B? 选择疑问句，并用 They aren't A. They're B. 回答
认识一系列职业词（policeman, nurse, sales rep, hairdresser …）
lead.summary: 第 17 课是公司参观：Jackson 向 Richards 介绍雇员 Nicola、Claire（键盘录入员）、Michael、Jeremy（推销员）和 office assistant Jim，双方用 How do you do? 正式问候。第 18 课把职业词铺开，用选择疑问句 Are they … or …? 操练十组职业。
lead.tips: ① How do you do? 只用于第一次见面，用同样的话回答，不是问身体状况（别答 I'm fine）；② What are their jobs? 问职业用 what + 复数 are，回答用 They're + 职业；③ 选择疑问句 Are they A or B? 不用 yes/no 回答，直接说 They aren't A. They're B.；④ 职业前口语省略 a：They're sales reps.；⑤ man/woman 构成复合职业（policeman/policewoman, milkman），复数变 men/women。

questions.q: What are Michael Baker and Jeremy Short's jobs?
questions.zh: 迈克尔·贝克和杰里米·肖特是做什么工作的？
questions.hint: 听 Richards 问 What are their jobs? 之后 Jackson 的回答。

questions.q: What do Nicola Grey and Claire Taylor do?
questions.zh: 尼古拉·格雷和克莱尔·泰勒是做什么工作的？
questions.hint: Jackson 介绍完两人后回答 What are their jobs?

questions.aZh: 他是我们办公室的助手。
questions.hint: Richards 问 Who is this young man? 后 Jackson 回答。

questions.q: What does Mr. Richards say when he first meets Nicola and Claire?
questions.zh: 理查兹先生初次见到尼古拉和克莱尔时说了什么？
questions.hint: 这是初次见面的正式问候语。

questions.q: Are Michael and Jeremy very busy?
questions.zh: 迈克尔和杰里米很忙吗？
questions.a: No, they aren't. They are very lazy.
questions.hint: 课文说 They aren't very busy! 与 They are very lazy.

questions.q: Why is 'How do you do?' answered with the same 'How do you do?' rather than 'I'm fine'?
questions.zh: 为什么 How do you do? 要用同样的 How do you do? 回答，而不是答 I'm fine？
questions.a: How do you do? is a fixed formal greeting for first meetings; it is answered with the same phrase, not a statement about health.
questions.aZh: How do you do? 是初次见面的固定正式问候语，用原句回答，并非询问身体状况，所以不能答 I'm fine。
questions.hint: 对比 How are you? 才问身体，答 I'm fine, thanks.

questions.q: Are they keyboard operators or air hostesses? — They aren't keyboard operators. They're air hostesses. / Are they postmen or policemen? — They aren't postmen. They're policemen.
questions.zh: 第 18 课操练：Are they ___ or ___ ? — They aren't ___. They're ___.（把下面 10 组职业挨个问一遍，二选一明确回答）
questions.a: Are they nurses or housewives? — They aren't nurses. They're housewives.
questions.aZh: 他们是护士还是家庭主妇？——他们不是护士，他们是家庭主妇。
questions.hint: 选择疑问句不用 yes/no，直接否定前者、肯定后者。

exercises.q: 汉译英：迈克尔·贝克和杰里米·肖特是做什么工作的？
exercises.a: What are Michael Baker and Jeremy Short's jobs?
exercises.note: 问职业用 What are + 复数 jobs；they 配 are。

exercises.q: 回答：What are their jobs?（键盘录入员）
exercises.note: 职业前口语省略 a，直接用 They're + 职业复数。

exercises.q: 汉译英：您好！（初次见面，正式）
exercises.note: 初次见面正式问候，用同样的 How do you do? 回答，不答 I'm fine。

exercises.q: 汉译英：他是我们办公室的助手。
exercises.note: our 是所有格形容词，后接名词；单数为 is。

exercises.q: 完成选择疑问句的回答：Are they postmen or policemen?
exercises.note: 选择疑问句不用 yes/no，要二选一：否定前者、肯定后者。

exercises.q: 汉译英：那些姑娘很勤奋。
exercises.note: those + 复数 women 配 are；hard-working 带连字符。

exercises.q: 汉译英：这个年轻人是谁？
exercises.note: 问人用 who；this young man 单数用 is。
